items.title: Yandex outage: data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots moved
items.title_zh: Cloudflare：Yandex 宕机期间恶意机器人只是转移阵地，并未停摆
items.title_en: Cloudflare: bots shifted, not stopped, during Yandex outage
items.summary: Cloudflare data shows that during the Yandex outage, malicious bots did not go dark but instead shifted behavior, contradicting popular claims that the incident disrupted Russian troll or bot operations.

items.title: Pg_vectorsearch: An index that is faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW
items.title_zh: Timescale 发布 pg_vectorsearch，声称 Postgres 向量索引速度超越 pgvector
items.title_en: Timescale's pg_vectorsearch claims faster Postgres vector indexing than pgvector
items.summary: Timescale/Tiger Data released pg_vectorsearch, a new Postgres vector index using a quantized IVF/PRISM approach claimed to be faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW, with active community discussion around limitations, filtering support, and competition.

items.title: How Amazon pushes up prices all across the Internet
items.title_zh: 亚马逊的市场势力如何抬高整个互联网的价格
items.title_en: Amazon's Market Power Pushes Up Prices Across the Internet
items.summary: An analysis of how Amazon's market power and business practices drive up prices across the broader internet, accompanied by a rich Hacker News discussion on e-commerce dynamics.

items.title: Tracing where LLM "slop" style comes from in the model and in training, and cutting it out [R]
items.title_zh: 追踪大模型“slop”文风在模型内部与训练各阶段的来源
items.title_en: Tracing where LLM "slop" style comes from in models and training
items.summary: The post traces where LLM 'slop' writing style lives in a model (a difference-in-means register direction present even in base models) and which training stages install it (SFT adds rhetorical structures, DPO amplifies buzzwords and markdown).

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 自研 Scion 替换 git
items.title_zh: Anthropic 用自研 Scion 版本控制系统全面替换 git
items.title_en: Anthropic replaces git with in-house Scion version control
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly replaced git with its self-developed Scion version control system, achieving major gains in merge throughput, resource usage, and CI checkout speed.

items.title: 首例 Stargardt 病患者植入视觉芯片，从失明到可辨识单词
items.title_zh: 首例 Stargardt 病患者植入 PRIMA 视觉芯片，重获识词能力
items.title_en: First Stargardt Patient Receives PRIMA Visual Chip, Regains Reading
items.summary: Science Corporation implanted its PRIMA visual chip in the first Stargardt disease patient, enabling the formerly blind patient to see letters and read a word during early rehabilitation.
